summary_for_children: Al-Ghashiyah asks us to look at the camel, the sky, the mountains and the earth and think how they were created.
environment_concept: A walk past the four things 88:17-20 asks us to look at: resting camels, a high open lookout for the raised sky, tall mountains standing up from the plain, and a wide flat plain spread out to the horizon. The Day and the Garden described in 88:1-16 are not pictured. No person is shown.
architecture_and_scenery: Resting camels, a raised viewing platform, tall peaks, a wide open plain.

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.

unique_world.visual_theme: A well among tall dunes under a wide sky with far mountains, and a camel resting by the trough

primary_mechanic.text: Match five real features of the camel (double eyelashes, closing nostrils, hump, broad padded feet, knee pads) to what each is for; then a sandstorm blows in, the camel kneels, and you must stand still on its downwind side for 4 seconds (88:17, look at the camels, how they are created).

unique_world.narrative_structure: A reading among the dunes, the camel and the storm, then a reading on the dune top
environment_behaviour: the storm blows and sand streams past
the camel kneels in the storm and rises after
unique_world.learning_objective: Look at how the camel is created (88:17)

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Look at the Wonders Around You
story_library.children_narration: Have you ever looked carefully at a camel? What about the sky, mountains, and the earth? Surah Al-Ghashiyah encourages people to observe these remarkable parts of creation. It also reminds us of the Hereafter.

world_idea.title: The Camel and Mountain Expedition
world_idea.description: Explore a beautiful desert with realistically animated camels, high mountains, and a dramatic open sky. Children complete observation activities connected to the Quranic signs.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
